meta.author: claude
meta.description: Stone wall, corner, level 2 of 3: L1 plus flourish 2. Outside corner joining two straight modules, with a corner pier. Going clockwise round a town its side arm (x 0) follows a module and its front arm (z 0) leads into the next. Not yet builder-tested: iron_bars, red_banner. Decoration step adds: banner_pattern.
meta.changes: Quality check round 1: the merlon pattern changed across the whole set so modules tile end to end (a cobblestone-slab half merlon at x 0, merlons at x 2 and 4: neighbours now alternate high / low instead of two merlons side by side). Corner merlons follow it (front arm: pier, crenel, merlon; side arm: pier, merlon, crenel). The L2 torch moved from the banner onto the merlon at (2, 6, 1); the lamp post that narrowed the corner turn to 1 block is gone. Arrow-slit niches on both faces (bars from L2).
